messages:
emma (docs): Heads up — quickstart 'hello world' tutorial has a broken auth link and an outdated SDK snippet. PR opened but needs a quick review before EOD. The link in the Auth section points to https://docs.redwoodinference.com/auth (404). Also the Node snippet still shows `client.createSession()` which should be `client.auth.create_session()` now.

raj (devex): Which PR number? I can take a look in ~30.

emma (docs): PR is https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 — WIP branch `qs-auth-fix`. I added notes to include both Node and Python examples for service-account usage and an env var example `REDWOOD_API_KEY`.

mike (eng): FYI SDK released a tiny patch in v1.3.2 — the recommended instantiation is now: 
```js
// Node snippet for quickstart
const { Redwood } = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const resp = await client.chat.completions.create({ model: 'gpt-small', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'hello' }] });
```
That should replace the old `createSession()` example.

raj (devex): I'll update the PR to swap the snippet and fix the broken link. Can we get a preview deploy after commits? @ci-bot can you run the preview? :pray: 

ci-bot: Preview build started for PR #482 — deploy preview URL: https://deploy-preview-482--docs.redwoodinference.net — status: successful ✅ (linkcheck ran, 1 warning about external link TTL)

lina (pm): Thanks folks. Also check the 'First deployment' section — keep the Hosted quickstart primary, but add a short pointer for Dedicated/private customers (link to /dedicated/migrate). Don't add full Dedicated steps into the same doc, just a migration note.

emma (docs): Added a migration note and a sentence clarifying Hosted vs Dedicated. Pushed another commit to the PR with the Node + Python snippets and the env var examples. Python snippet currently: 
```py
# Python quickstart
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
resp = client.chat.completions.create(model='gpt-small', messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "hello"}])
```
Can someone sanity-check the Python constructor name?

raj (devex): Small nit: the Python class is `RedwoodClient` but the preferred factory is `Redwood` in the new package; please use `from redwood import Redwood` then `client = Redwood(api_key=...)`. I'll update that line and also add a short note about rotating keys.

mike (eng): If you want, I can add a lightweight docs CI job to run a link-checker and a snippet parser so we catch these faster. I can PR that to `infra/docs-ci` — will reduce regressions.

emma (docs): Yes please — that would save time. I added a test checklist in the PR description for reviewers. Once the Node/Python snippet change is in and link-checker passes, we can merge.

raj (devex): Approved the PR after the Python rename. Leaving one optional comment about wording. :rocket:

emma (docs): Great — merging after the auto CI run completes. Thanks all! 

ci-bot: Merge check: all checks passed. PR #482 merged by emma (docs) — deploy to production scheduled. :tada:
